'''The Unmasked''' was a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was lead by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Kanoth]] and Lady [[Dominique]]. They were a cult devoted to attaining the same power that birthed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] by utilising a [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]].<ref name="UnmaskedCodex1">{{TORcite|The Unmasked: Ambitious Beginnings|type=codex|exp=lots}}</ref><ref name="UnmaskedCodex2">{{TORcite|The Unmasked: A Dark Experiment|exp=lots|type=codex}}</ref>
